> Minor · Compare ordered Troubleshooting values by order. · class-settings-manager.php:410-416
>
>
> > `admin/includes/class-settings-manager.php:410-416` > **🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win** > > **Compare ordered Troubleshooting values by order.** > > `troubleshooting_shows()` calls `is_default()`, which sorts arrays before it compares them. A save that changes only the order of an `ordered` multi field can therefore look like the default. If no other Troubleshooting setting differs, the section can start closed, even though its docblock says a saved choice is never hidden. No shipped field sets `ordered` in the Troubleshooting group, so this affects only an extension-added field. > > Compare ordered fields with `SEOProAnalytics_Settings::same()`, which keeps order for `ordered` fields. Keep `is_default()` for all other fields so their current behaviour does not change: > >
> Suggested fix >
>
> > ```diff > private static function troubleshooting_shows($key, array $field) { > - if (!self::is_default(self::value($key), isset($field['default']) ? $field['default'] : null)) { > + $default = isset($field['default']) ? $field['default'] : null; > + $matches = empty($field['ordered']) > + ? self::is_default(self::value($key), $default) > + : SEOProAnalytics_Settings::same(self::value($key), $default, $key); > + if (!$matches) { > return true; > } > ``` > >
